metaDescription: {body} of {city} on OpenCouncil: its meetings and its members.
meetingsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No published meetings} =1 {1 published meeting} other {# published meetings}}
noMembers: No members have been recorded for this body.
aboutPrimary: {type} of the municipality. Its meetings appear on the pages of the municipality with the other bodies.
aboutSecondary: {type}. The body publishes its own meetings here. They stay apart from the municipal council on the pages of the municipality.
contactsIntro: The channel that streams the meetings, and the addresses that receive the transcript.
youtubeChannelHint: With a channel, the platform finds the video of a meeting on its own.
contactEmailsHint: Separated by commas. They receive the transcript of every meeting.
invalidChannel: The channel link is not valid.
invalidEmails: One of the addresses is not valid.
adminsIntro: The accounts that manage the meetings and the members of the body. An invitation to a new address sends an email with a sign-in link.
adminAdded: The account is now an administrator
removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the administrators of the body?
lastAdmin: Only an administrator of the municipality can remove the last administrator.
importIntro: Paste the list of members as the decision writes it. One person per line, with their title when there is one.
importCheckIntro: Check the names and the titles. Remove any line that is not a member, then confirm.
importPlaceholder:
Chair: Maria Neanidi
Vice chair: Giorgos Nearos
Members: ...
importParseFailed: The list could not be read
importNobodyFound: No person was found in the text.
importSummary: {created} new people, {joined} existing people with a new role, {skipped} already members.
newTermConfirm: End the term of all {count} members today? They stay as former members, and you can import the new composition.
newTermDone: The term ended for every member
newTermFailed: Could not start a new term
claimLinksIntro: Each member gets an account and their page through a personal link. Send the link to the member and to nobody else. A member who also holds a seat elsewhere in the municipality, such as a councillor, gets their link from the city admin.
claimLinksNone: Every member has an account already.
embedIntro: A widget with the meetings or the hot subjects of the body, for its website or blog. Set the look and copy the code.
